metadata.name: chancery
metadata.description: Chancery devnet build: a policy-governed mint/redeem settlement rail, with the governance timelock floors reduced to the devnet minimum.

docs: Native Solana settlement program. Wire format: [module_id, ix_id, ...borsh args].
Account state is #[repr(C)] bytemuck with explicit padding fields.

constants.name: cross_chain_message_kind_extensions.INBOUND_RELEASE_FROM_REMOTE_LOCK
docs: Remote lock → local release. the specification

constants.name: cross_chain_message_kind_extensions.OUTBOUND_LOCK_FOR_REMOTE_RELEASE
docs: Local lock → remote release. the specification

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.EXPIRY_LAPSED
docs: The message carried a nonzero expiry and `now >= expires_at`.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.EXPIRY_POLICY_TIGHTENED
docs: A finite policy window rejects a zero or excessively distant expiry.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.PER_MESSAGE_CAP_TIGHTENED
docs: The message amount exceeds the current absolute per-message cap.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.PER_DAY_CAP_TIGHTENED
docs: The message amount exceeds the current absolute per-day cap, so it can
never fit even in an empty daily window.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.UNSUPPORTED_MESSAGE_KIND
docs: The authenticated message kind is not executable by this binary.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.ZERO_AMOUNT
docs: The authenticated message carries a zero amount, which consume rejects.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE
docs: The canonical u128 amount exceeds Solana's u64 token amount domain.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.REMOTE_ASSET_BINDING_INVALID
docs: The supported message kind cannot satisfy the corridor's mode/asset
binding and therefore can never execute under the attested content.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.PATHWAY_PER_TRANSACTION_CAP_TIGHTENED
docs: The amount exceeds the pathway's absolute per-transaction cap.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.PATHWAY_PERIOD_CAP_TIGHTENED
docs: The amount exceeds one of the pathway's absolute fixed-window volume caps
(hourly/daily/seven-day/thirty-day), so it can never fit even in an empty
window and is terminally unexecutable. Distinct from transient window
saturation, which clears with time and is deliberately not retired.

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT_FROZEN
docs: The attested recipient's exact canonical issued-token ATA exists and is

constants.name: inbound_message_retirement_reason.RECIPIENT_ACCOUNT_MISSING_OR_UNINITIALIZED
docs: The exact canonical issued-token ATA is absent or exists as an
uninitialized SPL token account. Recipients must create and initialize
their ATA before initiating the source-chain transfer.

constants.name: cross_chain_signer_set_flag.REVOKED
docs: Set explicitly when the signer set is revoked outside of normal
expiry - e.g. a key compromise. Verification rejects revoked sets

constants.name: extension_bit.PERMISSIONED_BURN
docs: Chancery-internal forward compat. Not a current Token-2022 extension.

constants.name: extension_bit.DORMANT_TRANSFER_HOOK
docs: TransferHook extension present with its program id set to None/zero.
This reserves future hook activation without executing a hook today.

constants.name: ix.events_cpi.EMIT
docs: No-op handler. Receives self-CPIs from emit_event; within a finalized,
successfully committed transaction, the inner instruction is the
evidence record. Decoders must reject failed transaction metadata.

docs: Permissionless authenticated terminal retirement of the strict
inbound nonce head (SL-01 remedy): consume minus value effects. A
message may retire after its nonzero expiry lapses or after a policy

constants.name: module.CROSS_CHAIN

constants.name: RATE_PRECISION_E9
docs: Rate fields are stored as fixed-point with 9 decimal places of precision.

constants.name: MINIMUM_AUTHORITY_TRANSFER_TIMELOCK_SLOTS
docs: Minimum slots that must elapse between `propose_authority_transfer` and
`accept_authority_transfer`. Devnet floor: one slot, the smallest value
that still keeps propose and accept in separate slots, so the rotation
path stays genuinely slot-gated while a transfer completes within a test
run. It provides no reaction window for off-chain monitors and carries no

constants.name: AUTHORITY_TRANSFER_ACCEPTANCE_WINDOW_SLOTS
docs: Slots after `executable_after_slot` during which an authority-transfer
proposal may still be accepted. Past this window the proposal is void and
must be re-proposed by the current governance authority, so stale
proposals can never linger as a latent rotation. 8 640 000 slots ≈ 30 days

constants.name: MAXIMUM_FREEFORM_FIELD_COUNT
docs: Maximum number of counterparty freeform report fields permitted by evidence

constants.name: MAXIMUM_FREEFORM_VALUE_BYTES
docs: Maximum byte length of a single freeform field value hash.

constants.name: role.PERMISSION_ROLE_SCHEMA_VERSION
docs: Persisted permission records bind their role bits to this exact schema.
A future binary that changes the meaning or availability of role bits
must perform an explicit state transition rather than silently giving
new meaning to previously persisted data.

constants.name: role.DEFINED_ROLE_MASK
docs: Every role position defined by this binary, including permanently
retired positions. Bits outside this mask were never defined.

constants.name: role.KNOWN_ROLE_MASK
docs: Backward-compatible name for the full defined role-position set.

constants.name: role.NON_ADMIN_GRANTABLE_ROLE_MASK
docs: Permission bits that a non-admin grantor may redistribute after the
grant itself completes the required governance ceremony.

constants.name: role.INACTIVE_RESERVED_ROLE_MASK
docs: Reserved role bits whose corresponding runtime actions are not present
in this binary. Permission records may not pre-grant these bits, even to
admins: a future program upgrade must deliberately remove the bit from
this mask before the capability can be granted.

constants.name: role.ACTIVE_ROLE_MASK
docs: Role bits that can be persisted and exercised by this binary. Retired
positions and declared-but-inactive module roles fail closed.

constants.name: role.GRANTABLE_ROLE_MASK
docs: Backward-compatible alias used by mutation code and external checks.

docs: Permission-redistribution and authority-adjacent capabilities that a

constants.name: role.DANGEROUS_PERMISSION_ROLE_MASK
docs: Roles that require a non-global scope, finite expiry, and the

constants.name: scope.COUNTERPARTY
docs: Per-counterparty limit dimension (scope_key = Pubkey::default() on the
template LimitPolicy; usage windows are keyed per counterparty key).
